entities.name: Tourism Development and Pitons World Heritage Site
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Tourism became Saint Lucia's primary economic driver, centered on the dramatic Pitons — twin volcanic peaks designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2004. Luxury resorts, eco-tourism, and cruise ship visits form the backbone of the modern economy.
